name: plainspoken
description: Write like a person, not an AI: anti-AI-tells engine with isolated judges, voice profiles, plain language, claims integrity and built-in kaizen.

profile.title: Voice profile
profile.description: Profile name or path to a profile TOML. "default" uses the shipped default profile.

locale.title: Spelling locale
locale.description: English variant the skills write in (en-AU, en-GB or en-US). A project config or a voice profile that sets one wins.

targets.title: Files to lint
targets.description: Globs the lint-watch hook checks after edits.

nudge.title: Writing nudge
nudge.description: On: when a prompt asks for an email, post, script or other writing, a one-line reminder names the plainspoken step that fits. Off by default.

rule.title: Drafting rule
rule.description: On: every session starts with a short rule to use plainspoken whenever it drafts or rewrites something people will read. Off by default.

tool_call.title: Tool-call check
tool_call.description: Lint the writing in an MCP tool call (an email, a post, a message) before it goes out. off (default), warn = tell you and Claude, block-once = hold the first try back, ask = you decide. A project or user-wide [tool_call] mode wins.

chat_reply.title: Chat-reply check
chat_reply.description: On: when you asked for writing and Claude's reply holds a draft (an email, a post, a text), its lint findings are shown to you at the end of the turn. Never to Claude. Off by default.

strictness.title: Gate strictness
strictness.description: watch = report only, warn = warn before publish, block = block publish without a current PASS.

ledger_excerpts.title: Store excerpts in the kaizen ledger
ledger_excerpts.description: Off keeps raw text out of the ledger (hashes only).

kaizen_adapter.title: Where kaizen proposals go
kaizen_adapter.description: file = markdown in .plainspoken/, github = issues, trello = cards (project config supplies IDs).
